## Target / Destino

## Checklist
- [ ] No secrets (`.env`, tokens, keys) in the diff
- [ ] No direct commits to `main` or `staging` — this is a `feat/*`, `fix/*`, or `chore/*` branch
- [ ] Branch named correctly (`feat/…`, `fix/…`, or `chore/…`)
- [ ] Ready for human approval before merge
